```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(flextable)
library(kableExtra)

output_format <- knitr::pandoc_to()

# flextable writes its own font into every table cell (default: DejaVu Sans),
# so the reference doc cannot override it. Word uses the hAnsi slot for most
# Latin text, so all four font slots must be set, not just font.family.
set_flextable_defaults(
    font.family = "Calibri",
    hansi.family = "Calibri",
    eastasia.family = "Calibri",
    cs.family = "Calibri",
    font.size = 11
)

# Table helper for docx output.
# - widths come from the chunk's #| tbl-colwidths option (flextable ignores it
#   on its own, it only applies to markdown tables); pass `colwidths` to override
# - removes flextable's default rule under the last row
cv_flextable <- function(df,
                         colwidths = knitr::opts_current$get("tbl-colwidths"),
                         text_width = 7) { # inches: 8.5in page - 2 x 0.75in margins
  if (is.character(colwidths)) colwidths <- yaml::yaml.load(colwidths)
  colwidths <- as.numeric(unlist(colwidths))
  if (length(colwidths) != ncol(df)) {
    message("cv_flextable: no usable tbl-colwidths, using equal widths")
    colwidths <- rep(1, ncol(df))
  }
  inches <- colwidths / sum(colwidths) * text_width

  ft <- flextable::flextable(df) %>%
    flextable::delete_part("header") %>%
    flextable::border_remove() %>%
    flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")
  for (j in seq_along(inches)) {
    ft <- flextable::width(ft, j = j, width = inches[j])
  }
  ft
}

```

# Education {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: education
#| tbl-colwidths: [10, 90]


education <- read_tsv("components/education.tsv")

if (output_format == "docx") {
    education <- education %>%
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(
            details,
            "\\{return\\}",
            "\n"
        )) %>%
        mutate(year = as.character(year)) %>%
        cv_flextable()

    education
} else {
    education %>%
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(
            details,
            " \\{return\\}",
            " \n"
        ))%>%
    mutate(details = linebreak(details)) %>% # add LaTeX-style linebreaks
    kableExtra::kable("latex", escape = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, col.names = NULL) %>% # Required formatting for line breaks
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position")) %>% 
    column_spec(1, width = "1in") %>% # Make sure table doesn't extend past the end of the page
    column_spec(2, width = "5in")
}

```

# Funding {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: funding
#| tbl-colwidths: [30, 70]

funding <- read_tsv("components/funding.tsv")

# Collapse all non-date fields into one column, separated by {return}
funding <- funding %>%
    mutate(
        pi = paste0("Principal Investigator: ", pi),
        coi = paste0("Co-Investigator: ", coi)
    ) %>%
    unite(details, -date, sep = " {return} ")

if (output_format == "docx") {
    funding <- funding %>%
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(
            details,
            " \\{return\\} ",
            "\n"
        )) %>%
        cv_flextable()

    funding
} else if(output_format == "gfm"){
    funding %>%
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(
            details,
            " \\{return\\} ",
            " <br>"
        ))%>%
    kable(col.names = NULL)
}else if(output_format == "latex"){
    funding %>%
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(details, "([$&%])", "\\\\\\1")) %>% # escape LaTeX special characters
        mutate(details = str_replace_all(
            details,
            " \\{return\\} ",
            " \n"
        ))%>%
    mutate(details = linebreak(details)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable("latex", escape = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, col.names = NULL) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position")) %>%
    column_spec(1, width = "1.8in") %>%
    column_spec(2, width = "4.2in")
}

```

# Publications {.unnumbered}

#| label: count-citations
# Read the file content into a single string
text_content <- readLines("references/papers.bib", warn = FALSE)
text_content <- paste(text_content, collapse = "\n")

# Count the number of papers
pattern <- "@"
paper_count <- str_count(text_content, pattern)

# Count the number of first author papers
pattern <- c("\\{*Hilton\\}", "@article\\{hilton")
first_author_count <- str_count(text_content, paste0(pattern, collapse = "|"))
